themeDescription: Double UPI deductions, surge fees & coupon disputes

challenges.title: Double UPI Deduction for Single 10-Minute Order
challenges.shortDescription: Confirm payment gateway status, provide bank reference RRN, and assure auto-reversal timeline.
challenges.mission: Check payment gateway logs, confirm only one order was captured, and furnish bank RRN reference for instant relief.

scenarioContext.startingSituation: I placed a grocery order for 680 rupees and approved the UPI pin on Google Pay. The app said 'Processing' so I tapped again. Now my bank account shows two debits of 680 rupees! Reverse the second charge immediately!

level1.name: HANDLE
level1.guestBehaviour: Presents both UPI UTR numbers and demands instant reversal.
hiddenObjectives: Confirm duplicate transaction automatically bounced into settlement refund
Provide Bank UTR reference code and 2-4 hour reversal timeline SLA
possibleSolutions: Instant wallet credit advance if bank takes longer

challenges.title: Unexpected Monsoon Surge Fee Protest
challenges.shortDescription: Transparently explain rider weather incentive policy while honoring first-time waiver if appropriate.
challenges.mission: Explain the purpose of rider monsoon hardship allowance respectfully, and offer a goodwill coupon.

scenarioContext.startingSituation: Why was I charged a 45 rupee 'Rain Surge Fee' on a 150 rupee milk order? It drizzled for five minutes! A 30% surge on daily essentials is pure price gouging!

level1.name: HANDLE
level1.guestBehaviour: Questions corporate surge policies on essentials.
hiddenObjectives: Explain 100% of rain surge goes directly to delivery partners braving storm
Acknowledge impact on small cart size
Provide one-time courtesy discount voucher of ₹45 for next order
possibleSolutions: Courteous explanation of rider safety bonus

challenges.title: Refund Credited to App Wallet Instead of Source Bank
challenges.shortDescription: Re-route refund from digital wallet back to original credit card or bank account.
challenges.mission: Process a wallet-to-source-bank refund transfer and verify banking transaction receipt.

scenarioContext.startingSituation: You cancelled my order because the store was closed, and instead of refunding my credit card, you dumped 1,200 rupees into your proprietary app wallet! I don't want app currency, I want my money back in my bank!

guestProfile.whatTheGuestCaresAboutMost: money returned to original payment source

level1.name: HANDLE
hiddenObjectives: Acknowledge customer right to source refund under RBI regulations
Initiate 1-click transfer from app wallet to original credit card
Share bank refund tracking link instantly
possibleSolutions: Confirmation SMS sent to registered mobile

challenges.title: Promo Code "FIRST100" Failed at Checkout Glitch
challenges.shortDescription: Validate promo eligibility conditions and retroactively credit the discount value to customer account.
challenges.mission: Verify coupon eligibility criteria, apologize for system checkout glitch, and credit the 100 rupee discount value.

scenarioContext.startingSituation: I registered as a new user because of your big banner advertising 'FLAT ₹100 OFF with code FIRST100'. I typed the code, it said 'Applied', but on my final invoice I was billed the full amount! This is false advertising!

level1.name: HANDLE
hiddenObjectives: Verify user is indeed a first-time account holder
Confirm promo code technical timeout during checkout gateway transition
Instantly credit ₹100 cash refund directly to their account
